lessons.keep: Use a clear amount-to-action-to-receipt sequence as the center of a financial product film.
try: For a payment demo, retain input amount, conversion or fee and recipient amount together until the receipt appears.
Try a shorter local-life montage followed by one user funding, scanning and confirming a payment before adding secondary benefits.
lessons.avoid: Avoid an unexplained amount change or a yield headline without the context needed to understand the offer.
lessons.open: Transaction reality, fees, custody, yield conditions, reach, bank status, asset sources and all sound remain unverified.
